class.name: OcgTdatastdTreenode
class.brief_description: Allows you to define an explicit tree of labels which you can also edit. Without this class, the data structure cannot be fully edited. This service is required if for presentation purposes, you want to create an application with a tree which allows you to organize and link data as a function of application features.
class.description: ! Allows you to define an explicit tree of labels ! which you can also edit. ! Without this class, the data structure cannot be fully edited. ! This service is required if for presentation ! purposes, you want to create an application with ! a tree which allows you to organize and link data ! as a function of application features.

method.name: Append
method.description: Insert the TreeNode <Child> as last child of <me>. If the insertion is successful <me> becomes the Father of <Child>.

method.name: Prepend
method.description: Insert the the TreeNode <Child> as first child of <me>. If the insertion is successful <me> becomes the Father of <Child>

method.name: InsertBefore
method.description: Inserts the TreeNode <Node> before <me>. If insertion is successful <me> and <Node> belongs to the same Father.

method.name: InsertAfter
method.description: Inserts the TreeNode <Node> after <me>. If insertion is successful <me> and <Node> belongs to the same Father.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Removes this tree node attribute from its father node. The result is that this attribute becomes a root node.

method.name: Depth
method.description: Returns the depth of this tree node in the overall tree node structure. In other words, the number of father tree nodes of this one is returned.

method.name: NbChildren
method.description: Returns the number of child nodes. If <allLevels> is true, the method counts children of all levels (children of children ...)

method.name: IsAscendant
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute is an ascendant of of. In other words, if it is a father or the father of a father of of.

method.name: IsDescendant
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute is a descendant of of. In other words, if it is a child or the child of a child of of.

method.name: IsRoot
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute is the ultimate father in the tree.

method.name: Root
method.description: Returns the ultimate father of this tree node attribute.

method.name: IsFather
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute is a father of of.

method.name: IsChild
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute is a child of of.

method.name: HasFather
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute has a father tree node.

method.name: Father
method.description: Returns the father TreeNode of <me>. Null if root.

method.name: HasNext
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute has a next tree node.

method.name: Next
method.description: Returns the next tree node in this tree node attribute. Warning This tree node is null if it is the last one in this tree node attribute.Returns the next TreeNode of <me>. Null if last.

method.name: HasPrevious
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute has a previous tree node.

method.name: Previous
method.description: Returns the previous tree node of this tree node attribute. Warning This tree node is null if it is the first one in this tree node attribute.

method.name: HasFirst
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute has a first child tree node.

method.name: First
method.description: Returns the first child tree node in this tree node object.

method.name: HasLast
method.description: Returns true if this tree node attribute has a last child tree node.

method.name: Last
method.description: Returns the last child tree node in this tree node object.

method.name: FindLast
method.description: Returns the last child tree node in this tree node object. to set fields =============

method.name: SetLast
method.description: TreeNode callback: ==================

method.name: AfterAddition
method.description: Connect the TreeNode to its father child list

method.name: BeforeForget
method.description: Disconnect the TreeNode from its Father child list

method.name: AfterResume
method.description: Reconnect the TreeNode to its father child list.

method.name: BeforeUndo
method.description: Disconnect the TreeNode, if necessary.

method.name: AfterUndo
method.description: Reconnect the TreeNode, if necessary. Implementation of Attribute methods: ===================================

method.name: ID
method.description: Returns the tree ID (default or explicit one depending on the Set method used).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Find
method.description: class methods working on the node =================================== Returns true if the tree node T is found on the label L. Otherwise, false is returned.

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Finds or Creates a TreeNode attribute on the label <L> with the default tree ID, returned by the method <GetDefaultTreeID>. Returns the created/found TreeNode attribute.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Finds or Creates a TreeNode attribute on the label <L>, with an explicit tree ID. <ExplicitTreeID> is the ID returned by <TDF_Attribute::ID> method. Returns the found/created TreeNode attribute.

method.name: GetDefaultTreeID
method.description: returns a default tree ID. this ID is used by the <Set> method without explicit tree ID. Instance methods: ================
